scope: Qualification-only null input to real SetTokenInformation(TokenDefaultDacl); original login, restricted and launch tokens retained; original error capture, first failure and deadlines unchanged.
required_evidence: Fresh disconnected VM041 passes original pristine-readiness checks.
All four roles use distinct empty D:/build_cache targets with fresh=false compiler outputs, exact source inventory and original controller checks.
Original setup succeeds; no token-refusal, setup-after-owned-accounts or late-create fault marker.
Precreated V5 trace has exact header, contiguous sequence, one owner, at most 512 records and 512 KiB.
Exactly one NativeStartEntered, InjectedNativeCallStarting, InjectedNativeCallReturned and FirstFailure, in order; one token derivation and one default-DACL call, zero process creation calls.

Real nonzero Win32 refusal reaches original FirstFailure as TokenSecurity / DefaultInitialization with the same code. Login/restricted/launch handles remain Held; process/thread outputs Empty; default phase changes SetInFlight to Unknown.
One original native-start attempt preserves returned error and Unknown; controller observations match exact journal byte ranges and hashes.
Same policy owner verifies and removes only its actually added right, preserves holder sets and closes its own policy resources.
One fixed 30-second quiet interval and one read of five allowlisted public files; separate transport closes; no retained-owner contact or replay.
failure_rule: Missing or contradictory evidence leaves the gate open; diagnostic trace is never cleanup authority.
diagnostic_coverage_exclusions: No trace promised before command retention or after append failure; absence proves nothing.
